sources.title: dolphin-2.9-llama3-8b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview dolphin-2.9-llama3-8b is an 8-billion-parameter language model fine-tuned from Meta's Llama-3-8B by cognitivecomputations for instruction-following, conversation, and coding tasks. The model was trained on 4,096 token sequences using full-weight fine-tuning on 8x L40S GPUs for 2.5 days with three epochs, making it computationally accessible while maintaining strong task performance ...
